cve_summary: coders/dds.c in ImageMagick allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service via a crafted DDS file.
commit_message: Added extra EOF check and some minor refactoring.
docstring:
/******************************************************************************  
Summary:  
Skips the mipmap images for compressed DXTn DDS files if applicable.

Parameters:  
image (Image*): Pointer to the image structure.  
dds_info (DDSInfo*): Pointer to the DDS information structure.  
texel_size (int): Size of a texel in bytes.  
exception (ExceptionInfo*): Pointer to the exception information structure.

Returns:  
MagickBooleanType: Returns MagickFalse if an error occurs; otherwise, it continues processing.

Logic:  
The function checks if the DDS file has mipmaps and is either a texture or a cube map. If so, it verifies that the image blob is not at the end of the file. It then iteratively skips over the mipmap levels by calculating the offset based on the width and height of the mipmaps, halving the dimensions for each level until all mipmaps are processed or dimensions become zero. If an unexpected end of file is encountered, it throws a file exception.  
******************************************************************************/
